results.description:
Free old map scroll 3D model. I've made this model using a few awesome old paper textures:

* [Vintage paper texture](https://www.photoshopsupply.com/patterns-textures/vintage-paper-textures)

* [Old map texture](http://www.textures4photoshop.com/tex/paper/vintage-old-map-texture-free-background.aspx)

Here's another attempt:

Explorers and swashbucklers of old used maps like this to navigate the high seas, and their journeys often ended in lasting mementos - tattoos that told tales of their adventures. [AI Tattoo Generator](https://www.mockofun.com/ai-tattoo-generator/) may not be able to replicate the salty ocean air or the creaking of wooden decks, but it can help modern-day buccaneers design their own treasure-worthy ink.

results.name: Haunted Mansion Project: The Greenhouse
results.description:
For the past several months, I have been doing research, Finding old HM concept art, discovering long lost lore, and eventually modeling the results to create a new Haunted Mansion dedicated to the Imagineers who brought it to life. Unlike many of the other components of the project, this is not based on an old concept, but is in fact my own addition.  This greenhouse, long abandoned, will be the centerpiece of the mansion's backyard. In it, you can find a variety of flora, from small parasitic buds like the hydnora to larger specimens such as the magnificent corpse flower. The top of the greenhouse is designed to match the conservatory built into MK's Haunted Mansion.

This is my first attempt at using generative flora in Blender, using the built in IvyGen add-on. I originally wanted to use the BagPie Ivy generator which produced a much more filled result and looked amazing, but the result was a 12 million polygon 3.2GB monstrosity so IvyGen appears to be much better for uploading to sketchfab. Enjoy!
